description: Count keyword or phrase frequency and density (occurrences per 100 words) across a block of text, the way an SEO keyword-density checker does. With the default ngramSize of 1, common English stopwords and words shorter than minWordLength are excluded; for ngramSize 2 or 3 (phrases), stopwords are kept since useful phrases often contain them.

ngramSize.description: Phrase length in words: 1 for single words, 2 or 3 for phrases (default 1)

topN.description: Number of top keywords/phrases to return (default 10)

name: analyze_keyword_density
